messages:
mike_pm: Hey team — customer on Private (vpc-deploy-347) is hitting repeated 502s + high tail latency when calling /v1/generate. They see 500ms->2s spikes and then timeouts. Need a debug bundle and repro steps. request_id from logs: req_0a9b6f2c. Can we collect and upload?

sarah_support: Can you paste the exact curl you used or the SDK call? Also need the service logs (model server + nginx) and the request_id you mentioned.

mike_pm: Minimal curl I used (sanitized):

```bash
curl -i -X POST "https://private-api.example.com/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0", "input":"Summarize the experiment logs", "max_tokens":64}'
```

mike_pm: I'll also grab /var/log/redwood/runtime.log and /var/log/nginx/error.log but wanted to confirm collector + redaction steps so we don't leak customer keys.

sarah_support: Perfect. For Private, use the helper on the host: `/opt/redwood/bin/rdw-collect` — it collects runtime, nginx, system info and packages into a tar.gz with a redaction pass. Example: 

```bash
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/rdw-collect \
  --out /tmp/redwood-debug-1758501234.tar.gz \
  --paths /var/log/redwood /var/log/nginx /etc/redwood \
  --request-ids req_0a9b6f2c \
  --redact --keep-raw false
```

sarah_support: Flags: `--redact` runs the configured redact rules (keys, auth headers, x-api-key, KMS ARNs). `--keep-raw false` ensures we only upload redacted archive.

ben_infra: Also collect a KV-cache snapshot if the model server supports it: `/opt/redwood/bin/kv-dump --out /tmp/kv-1758501234.json` (filter before upload). If KV contains user prompts, redact or omit.

mike_pm: When I run rdw-collect it warns about large /var/log volumes — any quick filters?

sarah_support: Use `--paths /var/log/redwood/runtime.log /var/log/nginx/error.log` to restrict to files. If runtime.log is rotated, include the last 2 files: `/var/log/redwood/runtime.log*`. Also add `--since "-1h"` to limit logs to last hour.

mike_pm: Got it. After I create `/tmp/redwood-debug-1758501234.tar.gz`, how do I upload securely? Customer can't share S3 creds.

sarah_support: Two options:
1) Generate a presigned upload URL from support console (short-lived) and POST the tar.gz there. I can do that once you confirm file size (<1GB).
2) If file >1GB, we usually instruct to run `aws s3 cp` to a customer-owned support bucket with a one-time IAM role we create and limit. We'll try presigned first.

mike_pm: File is ~210MB after redaction. Can you create a presigned link?

sarah_support: On it. @debug-bot, please create a presigned upload for channel=support, key=private-debug/mike_pm/1758501234.tar.gz, expiry=72h.

debug-bot: Generated presigned URL: https://uploads.redwood-internal/upload/abcd1234?sig=REDACTED (expires in 72h) — use curl PUT to upload.

sarah_support: Upload command: 

```bash
curl -X PUT "https://uploads.redwood-internal/upload/abcd1234?sig=REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/gzip" \
  --upload-file /tmp/redwood-debug-1758501234.tar.gz
```

sarah_support: After upload, reply here and I'll kick off the analyst review. Include the original request_id and the approximate timestamps of the failures (e.g., 2025-08-24T14:12:xxZ -> 14:17:xxZ).

mike_pm: Upload complete. HTTP/1.1 200 OK. Uploaded at 2025-08-24T14:48:06Z. Link returns 200 from curl.

ben_infra: A couple extra checks I'll run once I have the bundle: verify kernel dmesg for OOMs, check GPU driver logs (`/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`), and look at server-level CPU steal issues. If you can also paste the model config (batch_size, max_seq_len) that helps.

mike_pm: Adding model config from deployment YAML (sanitized):
```yaml
model: redwood-1.0
replicas: 3
batch_size: 8
max_seq_len: 2048
quant: fp16
```

mike_pm: Also saw an auth failure in audit: `auth: token_expired` at 2025-08-24T14:16:51Z but the requests that spiked are from same client with valid tokens. Not sure if related.

sarah_support: Noted — we'll grep audit logs for `req_0a9b6f2c` and related token events. If redaction removed tokens, provide the request_id mapping and approximate timestamps.

mike_pm: One more—should we also include `strace` of the model process? I can run `sudo strace -ff -p <pid> -o /tmp/strace-1758` but worried about performance impact.

ben_infra: Only if customer agrees — strace can be heavy. Prefer `gdb -p` mini-dump or use `rdw-proc-dump --light` which collects a lightweight backtrace without stopping the process. Use `--limit 30s`.

mike_pm: Customer signed off for a light dump. Running `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/rdw-proc-dump --pid 12345 --out /tmp/proc-dump-1758501234.tgz --light`.

mike_pm: All artifacts uploaded. Summary: presigned upload succeeded (200), request_id req_0a9b6f2c, failure window 2025-08-24T14:12:00Z -> 2025-08-24T14:18:00Z, bundle path `/tmp/redwood-debug-1758501234.tar.gz` (redacted).

sarah_support: Thanks — I'll assign to infra analyst and tag @ben_infra. We'll post findings here once we triage. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: Received the bundle, starting triage. Initial quick check: no OOMs in dmesg, but GPU driver logs show intermittent NVML timeouts around 14:15. Diving deeper.

mike_pm: Thanks team — will update customer that we have the bundle and triage started.

sarah_support: Closing loop: if we need raw (non-redacted) logs for a short window, we'll request explicit approval from the customer's security contact. No further action until infra update.
